question: What do we know about the generational wealth transfer, and how are these five preparing for it?

cells.label: fact

items.text: Edward Jones states that its business may be adversely impacted by the evolving financial services industry and generational wealth transfer, including changing client expectations for expanded product offerings and technology needs, and changing client demographics, preferences and values.
items.quote: The Partnership's continued ability to compete and adapt its business model may be adversely impacted by the evolving financial services industry and generational wealth transfer, including changing client expectations for expanded product offerings and technology needs, and changing client demographics, preferences and values.

items.text: Edward Jones attributes higher asset outflows partly to an aging client base and generational wealth transfers outside the firm, alongside macroeconomic volatility, inflation and consumer spending.
items.quote: These outflows are impacted by a variety of factors, including, without limitation, an aging client base and generational wealth transfers outside the firm, macroeconomic volatility, inflation and consumer spending.

items.text: Edward Jones cites an aging client base and generational wealth transfers outside the firm, along with macroeconomic volatility, inflationary pressures and shifts in consumer spending, as factors in elevated asset outflows.
items.quote: The outflows relative to the prior-year period continue an increasing downward trend influenced by several factors, including an aging client base, generational wealth transfers outside the firm, macroeconomic volatility, inflationary pressures, and shifts in consumer spending.

items.text: Edward Jones identifies generational wealth transfer and changing client demographics, preferences and values among the strategic risks it addresses through initiatives.
items.quote: The Partnership seeks to address its strategic risks, most notably competition for clients and personnel in light of the evolving financial services industry and generational wealth transfer, changing client demographics, preferences and values, technology, artificial intelligence, and regulatory changes

cells.reason: Multiple passages describe demographic trends (aging client base) and characteristics (generational wealth transfers outside the firm, changing demographics/preferences/values) defining the generational wealth transfer.
